theory.delta: Actual card N/maxG, activation/cue/loft/life settings are resolved individually. ARH gets only admitted range/Doppler; IR/SARH bench is angle-only and uses own speed. Midcourse support and loft remain model-specific permissions/settings, not fabricated target state.
theory.state: Terminal-acquired phase latch; admitted track capture epoch, bearing/rate and optional radar range/Doppler; measured midcourse support estimate. GuidanceStateResetV1 clears the latch on release/reset.
theory.io: Input: permission-admitted measured seeker result and own navigation pose/velocity/up, seconds/metres/radians. Output: ECEF specific-force demand, phase, tracking/support/holding availability. No target truth in this method.
theory.discretization: Measured bearing is propagated from its original capture epoch using its measured derivative, normalized, and projected transverse to own heading. Midcourse support extrapolates its own captured position/velocity only. Homing/lost phase remains latched after terminal acquisition; no automatic return to seeking.
theory.uncertainty: Card navigation gain/limit/activation/loft values retain their own basis, source and uncertainty. Sensor/navigation errors are not eliminated by this equation check. Shared PN implementation does not establish equal seeker observability or missile kinematics.
